description: Get the public profile of one provider (a dealer, auction house, marketplace or auction platform) by its listingSourceSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL (/shops/{slug}): name, operator, website and image. Each result's `viewLink.url` is the provider link meant to be shared with people: it carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed. `viewLink.affiliate` is `true` when that link is an affiliate link, which can earn Aura Historia a commission. `url` is the provider's untagged address.

listingSourceSlugId.description: Slug ID of the provider, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL.

name: getPublicListingSourceBySlug

PublicListingSourceOperatorData.description: The Party that operates a ListingSource, as shown wherever a source is presented publicly.

partner.description:
`true` while the operator Party has an active Aura Historia Partnership, otherwise
`false`, including after a Partnership is dissolved. Unrelated to ingestion methods and
referral configuration.

ViewLinkData.description: The provider link meant to be shared with people, paired with whether it is an affiliate link.

affiliate.description: `true` when `url` is an affiliate link, which can earn Aura Historia a commission when people follow it. `false` when it carries only Aura Historia's tracking parameters or leads to Aura Historia itself.

url.description: Link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people. It carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed.
The provider's own address, without Aura Historia's referral tagging; `viewLink.url` is the link meant to be shared.

viewLink.description: The link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people, and whether it is an affiliate link.

title: Get listing source
